target.title: fix(memory-core): use truncateUtf16Safe for dreaming narrative lead text
target.body:
## Summary

The `hasDreamingNarrativeLead` function in memory-core's short-term promotion module truncates LLM-generated snippet text with a raw `.slice(0, 200)` call, risking UTF-16 surrogate pair splitting when the text contains emoji or other multi-byte characters near the truncation boundary. Replace with `truncateUtf16Safe`, which is already imported and used elsewhere in the same file for safe truncation.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Fix UTF-16 surrogate pair splitting risk when truncating dreaming narrative snippet text at the 200-char boundary in `hasDreamingNarrativeLead`.

**Real environment tested**: Linux 4.19.112-2.el8.x86_64, Node.js 22.x, OpenClaw main @ 05d17289c9

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
```bash
# Run memory-core extension full test suite
pnpm test -- extensions/memory-core/
```

**After-fix evidence**:
```
 Test Files  65 passed (65)
      Tests  1026 passed (1026)
   Start at  09:07:16
   Duration  324.70s (transform 39.55s, setup 15.34s, import 136.32s, tests 157.60s, environment 11ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 338.18s
```

**Observed result after the fix**: All 65 test files pass (1026 tests), no regressions in memory-core extension.

**What was not tested**: N/A — this is a one-line replacement using an already-imported, well-tested utility function (`truncateUtf16Safe`). The fix follows the exact same pattern as the other three `truncateUtf16Safe` call sites in the same file (lines 363, 2355).

## Tests and validation

### Unit tests

```
pnpm test -- extensions/memory-core/

 Test Files  65 passed (65)
      Tests  1026 passed (1026)
   Duration  324.70s
```

## Risk checklist

- [x] This change is backwards compatible
- [x] This change has been tested with existing configurations
- [x] No breaking changes
- [x] `truncateUtf16Safe` already imported and battle-tested in the same file

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| extensions/memory-core/src/short-term-promotion.ts | `.slice(0, 200)` → `truncateUtf16Safe(withoutPrefix, 200)` |
